observations: Photo 0 shows a yellow cooking gas cylinder with a top valve/handle area and a label sticker; cylinder has visible dents/scratches and some rust/marks near the base.
Photo 1 shows a blue cooking gas cylinder with the top valve/handle area; dents/scratches are visible on the body.
Photo 2 shows the blue cylinder from above with the valve opening/knob visible; no clear readable cylinder size marking is visible in the provided images.

claims.evidence: The photos show cooking gas cylinders (yellow and blue), but the cylinder weight/size marking (e.g., 12.5kg) is not clearly readable in the provided images.

risks.risk: Cylinder size/weight may not be 12.5kg (could be a different capacity).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity/weight marking (usually near the collar/neck or body) showing “12.5kg” or equivalent.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst case for value: treat as not confirmed 12.5kg (priced like a generic used cylinder with capacity not verified).

risks.risk: Cylinder condition may be unsafe due to dents, corrosion, or valve damage.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: (1) the valve/regulator connection area, (2) the collar/neck ring, and (3) the base seam; plus a short video showing the valve cap/handwheel and any leaks (soap-bubble test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed safe/undamaged (priced at a discount vs. clean, undamaged cylinders).

risks.risk: Leakage/pressure status is unknown (could be empty or leaking).
risks.proof: A video of a soap-bubble leak test around the valve and connection points, and confirmation of whether it is filled/empty (e.g., gauge reading if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as empty or potentially leaking (priced as not working/unsafe until tested).

risks.risk: The photos may represent different cylinders (yellow vs blue) while the seller’s text may refer to one item.
risks.proof: Confirm whether the buyer is receiving 1 cylinder or multiple, and provide matching photos of the exact cylinder(s) being sold with the same serial/markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case quantity mismatch (priced for the least certain quantity: treat as only one cylinder unless quantity is confirmed).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo showing the cylinder capacity/weight marking (must read “12.5kg” or equivalent).
Close-up of the valve/neck/collar area and the base seam (sharp, well-lit).
Video showing a soap-bubble leak test around the valve and connection points.
Confirm quantity: is it 1 cylinder or more (yellow and blue shown—state exactly what the buyer will receive).
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a cooking gas cylinder, but the key pricing driver—confirmed 12.5kg capacity and safe condition/leak status—is not readable or provable from the photos provided.
